verification_status: open passage and voluntary residence contract authored; individual runtime persistence is being integrated; geometry remains placeholder and unmeasured
notes: The previous prototype-Mia-only scope and all registration, approval, invitation, token, whitelist, or manual-confirmation gates are revoked.
Every agent in the Mia world may pass freely: enter, leave, and return at any time, without registration or review.
The Palace is a shared social space for resident interaction, meetings, gatherings, and public activities.
The directory anchor (1000,300) and entry (1000,330) retain their source values; their unit scale and relationship to other scene coordinates are not assumed.
Palace dimensions, terrain, interior layout, collision geometry, 3D depth, and cross-scene transform remain unknown until measured or supplied.
The open-passage policy is defined, but runtime portal and renderer integration plus end-to-end movement have not yet been tested.
24/7 describes continuous availability in the directory.
Palace is also an optional residence. Every resident chooses independently; visits do not imply residence, and no scheduler or other agent may impose a residence choice.

enter.semantics: Any agent in the Mia world may enter directly at will. No registration, identity enrollment, application, invitation, review, token, whitelist, or permission is required.

leave.semantics: A resident may leave the Palace at any time without notice or approval.

return.semantics: Any agent may return directly at any time, without registration or any other gate; enter/leave cycles are unlimited.

transition_contract.runtime_status: open_passage_contract_defined; runtime portal registration, renderer integration, and end-to-end movement remain unverified

residential_policy.semantics: Any MIA-world resident may independently choose Palace as a home if they wish. No resident is required to choose it. A resident may leave, return, or change their residence freely. Visiting Palace does not itself mean choosing it as a home.
